thread:
marco: Kicking off a small admin entitlement cleanup Friday. Want a quick consensus on the artifact package format for auditors.
tess: Short and repeatable please. Prefer one tarball per principal with: binding snapshot, KMS/key policy, bucket ACLs, notification log, and checksum/signature.
anil: Agreed. Minimal commands I run for each principal:
```
gcloud projects get-iam-policy $PROJ --format=json > $PRINCIPAL-bindings.json
gcloud kms keys get-iam-policy projects/$PROJ/locations/global/keyRings/$KR/cryptoKeys/$KEY --format=json > $KEY-iam.json
sha256sum *.json > manifest.sha256
tar czf evidence-$PRINCIPAL.tar.gz *.json manifest.sha256
```
ops: Ops will enable infra-agent guard `--deny-absent-role` in staging for the canary window. We'll also have `rebind-temp --principal X --ttl 1h` ready as a fast rollback.
legal: GPG detached signature + sha256 in a manifest is fine. Retention: 7 years. Ensure ticket ID included in the tarball.
marco: Good. Plan: dry-run Thu, 3-project canary Fri 01:00 UTC, larger sweep after green. Tess, can you add the exact export + upload steps to the runbook?
tess: Will do; I'll include upload to s3://compliance-archive/$RUN_ID and a note to copy the tarball SHA into the ticket.
sec-bot: IncidentBot: Created TASK-4987 "admin entitlements tidy - artifacts & canary" assigned to marco, tess.
anil: One safety nit: snapshot key IAM before removing any role and grep for principals in bucket/object policies. Silent KMS failures are the worst.
marco: Noted. We'll include an explicit KMS grep and a smoke-test after prune. Keep updates here.
